name: MEPDrawingProduction
description: Produce the MEP drawing set: tag first (the annotation pass and the rich tags read the tokens), then produce cropped plans from the Scope Box Planner's area boxes and from STING:: scope boxes, and whole-floor plans per level; then match lines (they quote sheet numbers, so they follow the sheets), then panel schedules. Production takes its inputs from each step's params instead of a dialog: with none given it produces every M, E, P, FP and MG Plan drawing type, on every level, as views and sheets. Re-runs reuse views and sheets matched by stamp, so it is safe to run again after model changes.

steps.label: Tag and combine the whole project (ISO 19650 tokens and tags the drawings annotate with)
Token confidence audit (elements that fell back to a default ZONE or LOC)
Produce MEP plans from the Scope Box Planner area boxes (runs only when the project has STING-AREA:: boxes)
Produce from STING::<type>::<level>::<zone> scope boxes (runs only when there are some)
Produce whole-floor MEP plans per level (runs only when the project has no area boxes; every M/E/P/FP/MG Plan type unless params.drawingTypes names them)
Match lines between adjacent and overlapping scope boxes (same drawing type, same level)
Build / refresh the STING panel schedule templates
Create the panel schedules (rule-based template pick, drawing-type stamp, ELC_PNL_* fill)

Panel circuit schedules on sheets: one per board, each on its own elec-panel-schedule-A3 sheet (re-runs reuse them; the native panel schedules still need dragging — Revit 2024+ cannot place them by API)

_notes: Step params: drawingTypes (comma list of ids; default every M, E, P, FP, MG Plan type), levels (comma list of level names; default all), output ('Views and sheets' | 'Views only'), duplicateOption ('Duplicate' | 'DuplicateAsDependent' | 'DuplicateWithDetailing'), packageId.
An unknown drawing type or level, or an unreadable output / duplicateOption, fails the step with the reason in the workflow report.
The production route is chosen by condition: area boxes when the project has STING-AREA:: boxes, whole-floor per level otherwise, and STING:: boxes whenever any exist.
